pwa.title: Energeia on your home screen
pwa.description: Get instant one-tap access to Cyprus energy news, market updates, and exclusive editorial longreads.
pwa.installGenericAlert: To install, open your browser options/settings and select 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install app'.
pwa.iosSafariDescription: Follow these simple steps in Safari to add Energeia to your device's home screen:
pwa.iosSafariStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom toolbar.
pwa.iosSafariStep2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
pwa.iosSafariStep3: Tap 'Add' in the top-right corner to complete installation.
pwa.iosChromeDescription: Follow these simple steps in Google Chrome on your iPhone:
pwa.iosChromeStep1: Tap the Share icon in Chrome's address bar (or the '...' menu icon).
pwa.iosChromeStep2: Scroll down the menu and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
pwa.iosChromeStep3: Tap 'Add' in the top-right corner to complete installation.
pwa.iosOtherDescription: Follow these steps in your browser to add Energeia:
pwa.iosOtherStep1: Tap the browser menu button ('...' or Share icon).
pwa.iosOtherStep2: Select 'Add to Home Screen' (or 'Open in Safari').
pwa.androidChromeDescription: Follow these simple steps in Chrome on Android:
pwa.androidChromeStep1: Tap the 3 dots menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome.
pwa.androidChromeStep2: Tap 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.
pwa.androidChromeStep3: Tap 'Install' to place the app on your home screen.
pwa.androidFirefoxDescription: Follow these simple steps in Firefox on Android:
pwa.androidFirefoxStep1: Tap the 3 dots menu (⋮) in Firefox toolbar.
pwa.androidFirefoxStep3: Confirm 'Add' to place the app on your home screen.
pwa.pushDescription: Get instant push notifications on your lock screen and timely updates right on your home screen icon.
pwa.pushNotSupported: Push notifications are not supported by your current browser.

cookies.subtitle: Information on Cookies & Web Analytics
cookies.s1_text: Cookies are small text files stored on your browser or device when visiting web portals. They ensure smooth navigation, preserve user preferences, and help us analyze platform traffic.
cookies.s2_text:
Essential Cookies: Required for fundamental site navigation and language localization settings (e.g. app_lang choice).
Analytics Cookies: Aggregated, anonymized statistical measurements on site traffic and article reads.
Functional Cookies: Remember display choices and progressive web app (PWA) installation preferences.
cookies.s3_text: You can control, block, or delete cookies at any time via your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may impact certain interface functionality.
cookies.s4_text: Energeia utilizes privacy-focused, GDPR-compliant analytics engines to optimize performance without sharing raw personal data with third parties.
cookies.s5_text: For questions regarding our Cookie Policy, reach us directly at admin@energeia.cy.
